result.title: DyLoMo-DiT: Dynamic Looped Mixture-of-Experts Diffusion Transformers
result.comment: 46 pages, 29 figures, 33 tables. Code, weights and project page: https://oneboxcream.github.io/DyLoMo-DiT/
result.summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) scale model capacity by increasing both parameter count and computation. Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) variants expand parameter capacity while keeping per-token computation roughly fixed, but still require substantial parameter storage. In this paper, we propose Dynamic Looped MoE DiT (DyLoMo-DiT), which reuses parameters rather than adding them: a weight-shared loop repeatedly applies the middle layers, while sparse experts allocate parameter capacity across tokens. This design deepens the network without adding parameters, freeing the parameter budget for other uses, such as more experts or more distinct layers. It also allocates compute dynamically, varying the number of passes across noise levels. Experiments show that DyLoMo-DiT makes more effective use of parameter and compute budgets, with further gains from assigning more passes to low-noise steps. On ImageNet $256\times256$, DyLoMo-DiT reduces FID by 11-24% relative to DiT and 36-56% relative to DiT-MoE at matched parameter and compute budgets. For text-to-image generation, a scaled DyLoMo-DiT achieves a higher GenEval score than FLUX.1 (0.714 vs. 0.673), with less than one tenth of its active parameters (1.05B vs. 12B).

AI.brief_summary: 提出 DyLoMo-DiT：以权重共享的循环方式重复应用中间层、并结合稀疏专家复用参数容量，同时按噪声水平动态改变循环次数，在 ImageNet 256×256 与文生图上验证其在参数与计算预算上的效率。
AI.relevance_reason: 权重共享循环与按噪声级分配计算，可能为 LVR 中循环式推理状态更新和动态计算预算（THINK/LOOK/STOP 类决策）提供方法线索，但该工作面向图像生成、未涉及推理状态与证据使用，可供核查其迁移可行性。
